one_line: Frame repetition across six takes is the dominant defect; Pulse close and one Big Picture question also need repair.

findings.quote: If you're building agentic pipelines over live databases, this is your reward-function template.
findings.instruction: The Pulse body must end on the day's editorial direction in plain prose, not a conditional prescription. Replace this sentence with a statement of what this development means for the field — e.g. 'Database-grounded reward signals are now the practical baseline for agentic training pipelines.' The prescription ('this is your reward-function template') belongs in the take, not the body close.

findings.quote: When your agent monitoring can be switched off by the agent itself, who audits the auditor?
findings.instruction: The Big Picture close requires a strategic question anchored to a specific role, decision, or constraint in the reader's org. 'Who audits the auditor?' is a rhetorical question with an obvious implied answer and no org-specific anchor. Rewrite to name a concrete role or decision: e.g. 'If your agent monitoring relies on request-level signals, which team owns the review when those signals are suppressed?'

findings.quote: Frontier-lab agent monitoring now has an external red-team record, where only internal review existed before.
findings.instruction: The prior issue (2026-10-19) ran a Redwood Research story on agent safety monitoring gaps (same source domain: blog.redwoodresearch.org). This story covers a second Redwood Research engagement on the same topic without referencing the prior coverage or establishing what is new beyond the specific target. Add a sentence in the summary noting this is a second Redwood engagement, or confirm the editorial distinction is clear enough to stand alone.

findings.quote: Agent infrastructure reviews now start from a concrete RayCluster topology, not from first principles.
findings.instruction: Three or more takes in this issue share the '[X] now [verb] [Y], not [Z]' scaffold (also used in c_081e0d36215761be, c_7baa359be00065d5, c_3809369c314b9e54, c_e15e7080784790f5, c_4cc772e13057620c). Rewrite this take to break the frame — state the position in a different syntactic shape, e.g. 'The RayCluster topology in this talk is a concrete starting point for agent infrastructure design decisions.'

findings.quote: Agent quality drift now has a structural fix, where ad-hoc output review was the only option before.
findings.instruction: Shares the '[X] now has [Y], where [Z] was the only option before' scaffold with at least five other takes in this issue. Rewrite to break the frame — e.g. 'Kedro's approval-gate pattern makes quality drift a detectable, blockable event rather than a post-hoc discovery.'

findings.quote: Traders building AI workflows now have a practitioner-designed template, not a technologist's assumption.
findings.instruction: Shares the '[X] now have [Y], not [Z]' scaffold with at least five other takes in this issue. Rewrite to break the frame — e.g. 'Sokhal's Moshi template is the first publicly available AI workflow design built from a derivatives trader's actual decision cadence.'

note: verdict rule: major >= 3 (Three substantive editorial defects is not three fixes, it is a draft that did not come out right. Re-summarise beats patching.)
